items.question: M Should | order the supplies now, or we week? ER w
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：问句或陈述是“M Should | order the supplies now, or we week? ER w”，自然应答是“Actually, | already sent the order.”。选择理由：该项在语义和会话功能上直接承接前句；其余选项只是词汇相关、时态不合或答非所问。正确答案：B（Actually, | already sent the order.）。
